main_body: A round leafy canopy/bush blob in mottled greens with no trunk, about 46 rows tall and 46 wide
top_band: none - the column scan shows mottled green noise (L 64/94/155) with no distinct lighter top band separated from a front face
evidence: The object is a foliage mass drawn as a roughly circular blob of random light/mid/dark green pixels. There is no top band, step, front edge line or front face. Light and dark greens alternate irregularly down every column, so no horizontal surface reads. No trunk or base is shown. It has no top/front structure, so it fails the 3/4 contract strictly.

style.evidence: The candidate uses only 4 distinct colours (near-black outline plus 3 greens) versus 427-567 in the references and a median of 4 colours per tile versus about 108. The outline is a uniform neutral near-black (100% neutral dark edge pixels), the 'sticker' look, whereas the references use tinted dark green outlines (0% neutral). The three-green dither noise gives some variation and no 5x5 flat fills, but it lacks the leaf clumps, highlights and clustered shading of the references, so it reads as a flat noise pattern. No trunk, and far shallower than the reference.
